setting.bebpm.radius_x.tooltip: How far east and west of the table bookshelves count. Never below vanilla's 2. Needs a restart.
setting.bebpm.radius_z.tooltip: How far north and south of the table bookshelves count. Never below vanilla's 2. Needs a restart.
setting.bebpm.radius_up.tooltip: How far above the table bookshelves count. Never below vanilla's 1. Needs a restart.
setting.bebpm.radius_down.tooltip: How far below the table bookshelves count. Needs a restart.
setting.bebpm.line_of_sight.tooltip: Off: every bookshelf in range counts. Decor only: solid blocks between the table and the shelf block it, except blocks in #bebpm:power_permeable. On: every block between must let power through, as vanilla's transmitter tag. Needs a restart.
